title: J Cru's Latest Single, "Glonky" (feat. INJI): A Wild Ride into the Party Scene
htmlContent:
LA-based Hip Hop duo J Cru has released their latest single, "Glonky" (feat. INJI), and it's a wild ride into the party scene. Inspired by the viral 'Glonky interview' on Youtube, the song is a high-energy ode to pre-game, parties, and everything.

The duo of J Geezy and J Smitty showcases their intricate lyrical skills and comedic chops in this track, accompanied by the soaring vocals of rising star INJI. The song follows their 2023 lead single "Man Cake" and promises to be a hit among Hip Hop and party music lovers.

J Cru's love for Hip Hop, unwavering ambition, and dedication to their craft is evident in their comprehensive and finessed work. With over sixty original tracks spanning four years, the duo's journey has been one to watch.

The song "Glonky" is a fun and energetic addition to J Cru's expanding discography, and we can't wait to see what they have in store for us next.
